prompts.normalChef:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: production mascot expression sheet for the Food Felonies mobile app commercial.
Reference image: the supplied app design sheet is a STYLE REFERENCE only, especially the friendly chef-hat mascot on the third phone. Create a new polished expression sheet; do not reproduce the phones or the UI.
Primary request: THREE LARGE matching chef mascot heads in one horizontal row on a genuinely transparent background. Same character, same proportions, same head silhouette, same clean large puffy white chef toque, same warm cream face and small red neckerchief. Only facial expressions change left to right: (1) curious, relaxed eyes, one eyebrow slightly lifted, small closed smile; (2) cheeky mischievous grin, raised eyebrow, friendly confident eyes; (3) excited delighted smile, bright wide eyes, joyful but natural and appealing.
Style: premium professional character illustration for an energetic food brand. Refined flat 2D with gently hand-inked espresso contours, subtly varied organic stroke, tiny restrained warm shading, elegant rounded geometry. Attractive normal cartoon faces with balanced recognizable features, two clean eyes with aligned pupils, clear brows and nose, one simple clean mouth. Mature witty food-brand personality, not childish emoji. Eyes visible, no sunglasses. Off-white chef hat, warm cream face, espresso lines, small vermilion red scarf. Tiny mustard detail allowed.
Composition: landscape 3:1 sheet, heads equally sized and centered, generous fully transparent gaps, full hats and scarves entirely inside frame, no overlap, crisp large shapes suitable to read at 120 pixels. Each of the three character heads is one separate floating cutout on alpha.
No words, labels, logos, captions, cards, speech bubbles, backgrounds or drop shadows. No radioactive color, slime, green skin, third eye, fangs, crooked teeth, distorted anatomy, uncanny features, huge toothy mouth, vector clip-art crudeness, 3D plastic, photorealism. Character consistency and impeccable clean facial anatomy are essential.

prompts.toxicChef:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: SIX-STATE CHARACTER PROGRESSION SHEET for an energetic food-crime slider in the Food Felonies app commercial.
Input image: use the supplied chef expression sheet as the CHARACTER IDENTITY AND RENDERING STYLE reference. Preserve this exact appealing brown-haired chef, warm cream skin, elegant white toque, small red neckerchief, rich espresso outlines and polished warm cel shading. The character must remain beautifully drawn with clean anatomy.
Primary request: render SIX consistent bust/head cutouts, neatly arranged THREE COLUMNS by TWO ROWS on genuine transparent alpha. The SAME chef becomes progressively more comically toxic, rebellious and energized with each state. Read order top left to right, then bottom left to right.
State 1 top-left: normal confident curious chef, small knowing smile, white hat upright, no protective gear, no vapor.
State 2 top-middle: mischievous raised eyebrow and devilish grin, sturdy round protective goggles resting neatly on forehead beneath hat, one tiny lime vapor curl off to the side.
State 3 top-right: fit a clean believable charcoal full-face GAS MASK to this chef; two symmetric round glass eye windows, properly centered rounded respirator over nose and mouth, TWO symmetric circular side filter canisters. Chef eyes visible through clear lenses; lively cheeky eyes and brows. A few small lime vapor curls.
State 4 bottom-left: SAME correctly constructed gas mask, SAME lens placement and filters, more manic delighted wide eyes and brows, slight head tilt; three stronger vivid lime-green vapor curls frame the silhouette, hat still pristine white.
State 5 bottom-middle: SAME gas mask and two filters with restrained neon-green vents and lively glowing green lens reflections, excited zany eyes still discernible; hair a little more tousled, hat playfully tilted, lively lime vapor plume and a few small spark shapes.
State 6 bottom-right: maximum food-felony chaos, SAME mask with dramatic green illuminated round lenses and clear filter geometry, ecstatic comically unhinged eyes behind glass, hat tilted a little further, wild but well-designed lush lime-green vapor plume and small red/mustard impact sparks around the head. Strong readable final silhouette. Cool punk-rock energy and premium branding, never horror or grotesque.
Composition: 3x2 grid with large generous transparent gutters, each character isolated entirely within its own equal cell, full hat, scarf, mask, filters and vapor contained. Same scale, same pose framing, consistent hat/head identity across all six, camera front with only small expressive tilt. Make the toxic escalation obvious at small display size. Keep face structure and mask mechanically coherent at every stage.
Style: polished professional 2D mascot illustration, confident clean hand-inked espresso contour, subtle warm dimensional cel shading, creamy white hat, warm skin, red scarf, charcoal gas mask, vibrant pickle/lime green toxic accents. More sophisticated expressive food-brand mascot than children's sticker.
NO text, labels, numerals, meter, UI, boxes, borders, logos, backgrounds or ground shadows. NO green skin, third eye, fangs, mutations, extra facial features, missing straps, melted lenses, mismatched filter canisters, broken geometry, cut-off hats, overlapping figures, warped anatomy or 3D plastic. High quality and consistent identity are essential.
prompts.toxicCleanup:
Edit target: the supplied six-state Food Felonies chef progression sheet.
Keep the exact six character designs, their order, identity, faces, gas-mask construction, hat design, illustration quality and colors. Make ONLY a production-art cleanup: remove the ENTIRE hazy brown backdrop and ambient bloom, and separate the characters cleanly on TRUE transparent alpha.
Deliver a clean 3-column by 2-row transparent sprite sheet, each whole head centered in its own equal cell. Scale each whole character including its vapor to occupy NO MORE THAN 76 percent of its cell width and 82 percent of its cell height. This leaves broad perfectly transparent gutters and generous padding on all four outer edges. No parts of adjacent states can overlap or bleed into each other. Every full hat, scarf, mask, filters, vapor curl and spark must fit inside its own cell.
Preserve the defined, crisply edged lime smoke curls and red/mustard sparks as foreground artwork, but REMOVE all diffuse background fog, brown clouds, gradient, glow halo, drop shadow and brown translucent pixels around the cutouts. Outside the six discrete artwork silhouettes every pixel must be fully transparent, including between all heads. Opaque fully colored character artwork and transparent empty space. Not a checkerboard picture, no backdrop of any kind.
Top row is normal chef, chef with goggles up, chef with gas mask. Bottom row is gas mask with vapor, glowing lenses, maximum toxic chaos. Keep these progressively crazier as already shown. No words, labels, numbers, cells, grid lines or new objects. Crisp finished professional isolated PNG sprite-sheet art.

animationDirection.notes: Clean to mischievous, fitted gas mask, increasing vapor, glowing lenses, maximum chaos. Use sprite transitions, not facial warping. Typography remains typed deterministic motion graphics.
